Description of the Retention Holder 
Five Arrows Global Loan Investments  II PLC will act as retention holder (in such capacity, the “Retention 
Holder”) for the purposes of the EU/UK Retention Requirements. For a description of the Retention Holder, see 
“Description of the Retention Holder”.  
The Retention 
On the Issue Date, the Retention Holder will execute the Retention Undertaking Letter addressed to the Issuer, 
the Trustee (for the benefit of the Noteholders), the Collateral Administrator, the Collateral Manager, the Arranger, 
the Co-Placement Agents and the Initial Purchaser. 
The Retention Holder reasonably believes that it is an “originator” (as such term is defined in, and for the purposes 
of, the EU/UK Retention and Transparency Requirements). Pursuant to the Retention Undertaking Letter, the 
Retention Holder will, for the benefit of the Issuer, the Arranger, the Initial Purchaser, the Co-Placement Agents, 
the Trustee, the Collateral Manager and the Collateral Administrator: 
(a) undertake to acquire on the Issue Date, for its own account, and hold on an ongoing basis for so long as 
any Class of Notes (other than the Subordinated Notes) remains Outstanding, a material net econom i c 
interest in the first loss tranche of not less than five per cent. of the nominal value of the securiti sed 
exposures through the purchase and retention o f Subordinated Notes such that the original Principal 
Amount Outstanding (such original Principal Amount Outstanding calculated as of the date of issuance 
of such Subordinated Notes)  multiplied by the purchase price (such purchase price calculated by 
reference to the issue price of the Subordinated Notes on the date of issuance of such Subordinated Notes) 
thereof equals or exceeds five per cent. of the Collateral Principal Amount (the “Retention Notes”) 
pursuant to Article 6(3)(d) of the EU/UK Securitisation Regulations; 
(b) agree not to sell, hedge or otherwise mitigate its credit risk under or associated with the Retention Notes, 
except to the extent not restricted by the EU/UK Retention Requirements;
